'''Tōru Furuya''' (Japanese: '''古谷徹''' ''Furuya Tōru'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is also sometimes credited as '''Noboru Sōgetsu''' ('''蒼月 昇''' ''Sōgetsu Noboru'').

==Biography==
Furuya was born on July 31, 1953, in {{wp|Yokohama}}, {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He already started an acting career as a child, being part of the children's acting troupe {{wp|Himawari Theatre Group|Gekidan Himawari}}. As an adult, he started landing a number of famous roles, usually in anime series. Furuya occasionally provided his voice for  {{aniseries|PTS}} since {{aniseries|OS}}, though he was best known as the [[Castelia City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Burgh]], who appeared in {{aniseries|BW}}. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}. He was married to fellow voice actress {{wp|Mami Koyama}} from 1976 to 1983, and is now married to another voice actress, Satomi Majima.
